data.name: Dominique
data.gender_notes: Dominique is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin dominus, meaning 'master' or 'lord'. In Christian contexts, the name Dominique is associated with the divine dominion and rule of God. The name Dominique carries the meaning “Master, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dominique usually hope their child will grow to embody master, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes submission and trust in God's sovereignty.

in_hebrew.name: דומיניק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם דומיניק נגזר מהמילה הלטינית 'דומינוס', שפירושה 'אדון' או 'אלוהים'. הוא קשור לשלטון ולכוח הרוחני של האל. השם משקף את הערכה וההערצה לאלוהים כמושל העליון והאדון של כל דבר.

in_greek.name: Δομίνικος
in_greek.meaning: του Κυρίου, που ανήκει στον Κύριο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Δομίνικος προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη 'dominus', που σημαίνει 'Κύριος' ή 'Αγκύριος'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο όρος 'Κύριος' χρησιμοποιείται συχνά για να δηλώσει τον Ιησού Χριστό ως τον Αδόνα και τον Σωτήρα. Το όνομα αντανακλά την πίστη και την αφοσίωση στον Θεό.

in_latin.long_meaning: The name Dominique is derived from the Latin word 'dominus', meaning 'lord' or 'master'. It signifies a relationship with God as the supreme ruler and lord of all. In Christian tradition, the name conveys devotion and reverence to God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dominique has a rich cultural heritage as it was common among the early Christians and French populations. It gained popularity in the Middle Ages and Renaissance periods, particularly among the nobility and clergy. Today, it is still used in the French-speaking world as well as in other Christian communities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian belief, the name Dominique signifies the ultimate authority and rule of God over our lives. It is a reminder of God's sovereignty and power, and a call to submit to His will. Dominique is a powerful name that evokes a sense of reverence, humility, and trust in the providence of God. It is a name that inspires us to live in accordance with God's law and to strive for holiness in all aspects of our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dominique, derived from the Latin word "dominus," meaning "lord," represents a strong connection to God as one's personal ruler and master. It symbolizes submission to divine guidance and the pursuit of a life devoted to the will of God.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Dominique de Guzman (1170-1221) was a Spanish priest and founder of the Dominican Order. The name Dominique carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
